question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(3)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**comprises**" is the correct form because it is the present tense verb that agrees with the subject **"National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC),"** which is singular. (समावेश करना)
 
• It means to **consist of **or to be made up of.
 
• The other options: "**comprise**" is the base form and does not agree with the singular subject, "**comprised**" is the past tense, and "**comprising**" is the present participle form but does not fit** grammatically **in this sentence structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** "The Government is implementing several programmes and schemes including the National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC), which **comprises**__ missions in specific areas of solar energy, energy efficiency, water, sustainable agriculture, Himalayan ecosystem, sustainable habitat, health, green India and..."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Comprise (समावेश करना):** to consist of; to be made up of.
 
• **Comprises (समावेश करना):** present tense of comprise, used for singular subjects.
 
• **Comprised (समावेश किया):** past tense of comprise.
 
• **Comprising (समावेश करते हुए):** present participle form used for ongoing actions.
